name: NetXMS
what_it_is: NetXMS is an open-source, enterprise-grade network and infrastructure monitoring and management system. It provides performance and availability monitoring with event processing, alerting, reporting, and graphing across all layers of IT infrastructure.
measurement: Routing table and ARP cache data
VLAN and switch forwarding database information
Wireless access point and client metrics
configuration: /etc/netxmsd.conf — server configuration (DB driver, connection params, ManagementAgentAddress, logging)
conf/pg/postgresql.conf — PostgreSQL tuning (mounted into db container)
conf/server/etc-netxms/ — additional server config directory (mounted as volume)
NETXMS_VERSION env var — pins container image version (required)
POSTGRES_DB / POSTGRES_USER / POSTGRES_PASSWORD — database credentials via .env
JAVA_OPTIONS env var — JVM heap tuning for web container (e.g. -Xmx1g)
KEYSTORE_PASSWORD + keystore.p12 mount — custom TLS certificate for web interface
fault_injection: nxdbmgr unlock — releases a locked database (run via docker compose run --rm unlock)
nxdbmgr upgrade / background-upgrade — schema migration (background-upgrade runs while server is live)
Agent proxy mode — agent can be stopped/isolated to simulate unreachable zone proxy
Server continues data collection autonomously when central management server is unavailable (edge-case resilience)
modes: Single-server deployment (all components on one host)
Distributed / zone-based deployment (proxy agents per network zone with overlapping subnets)
High-availability mode (multiple proxy agents per zone with automatic failover and load balancing)
Agent inbound mode (server connects to agent)
Agent outbound mode (agent connects to server, firewall-friendly)
Background DB upgrade (schema migration while server is running)
constraints: Docker images are linux/amd64 only; ARM builds are not yet available as official Debian packages for ARM are not released
NETXMS_VERSION environment variable is required — containers will not start without it (compose enforces :?)
ManagementAgentAddress must point to a running agent instance for web services and SSH checks to function
Database must be healthy (pg_isready) before server or init containers start (compose depends_on healthcheck)
background-upgrade profile is excluded from docker compose up and must be invoked manually
NXSL scripts run in isolated VMs with controlled access — no arbitrary host filesystem access from scripts
Web console default port is 8443 (HTTPS); HTTP port 8080 is available in the image but not exposed in the provided compose
docker_services: db — postgres:17, stores all NetXMS data, persists via db-data volume
server — ghcr.io/netxms/server, core engine, exposes ports 48920 (4701) and 48921 (4703)
agent — ghcr.io/netxms/agent, monitors the server host itself, used for web service / SSH proxy queries
web — ghcr.io/netxms/web, management console, exposes port 8443
init — one-shot DB schema initialisation (entrypoint /dbinit.sh), must complete before server starts
unlock — one-shot nxdbmgr unlock, run manually to release a locked DB
check — one-shot nxdbmgr check, run manually for DB integrity check
upgrade — one-shot nxdbmgr upgrade, run manually for schema upgrade
background-upgrade — nxdbmgr background-upgrade, manual profile only, safe to run while server is live
notable_absences: No built-in packet capture or flow analysis (NetFlow/sFlow not mentioned)
No native Kubernetes or container orchestration monitoring out of the box
No ARM/arm64 Docker images available yet
No built-in time-series database — relies on external PostgreSQL; InfluxDB and ClickHouse are optional fanout targets only
No simulation or replay mode for historical traffic described in documentation
